subject: textures DELTA8 plan/ABI: MSAA v3 + T2 formats
body:
DELTA8 plan/ABI before edits (render currently holds HEAVY; I will only do single-file host compiles until it releases, then take HEAVY once for release+ASan).

MSAA v3 (additive; v1/v2/v3? current v4 version numbers):
- n2r_render_targets gains `const uint32_t *sample_counts` and `const struct n2r_resolve_target *resolves` at end; N2R_RENDER_TARGETS_MSAA_VERSION=3. v1/v2 semantics and bytes untouched.
- struct n2r_resolve_target {uint64_t address; uint32_t format,row_bytes,width,height,reserved;}
- v3 requires sample_counts[count] entries, each 1 or 4; all target counts must match because FRAMEBUFFER has one sample_count. `resolves` may be NULL; otherwise count entries, address==0 means no resolve. A sample1 target with nonzero resolve or sample4 target with a resolve must satisfy exact same format/width/height/row alignment/span. No partial/inexact MSAA fallback.
- fb.sample_count=sample count; sample_pattern=SINGLE_SAMPLED for1/ROTATED_4X_GRID for4; sample_locations gets the pinned Mesa arch9 LUT (4 positions + origin at slot32; current single-sample all-centered bytes preserved for v1/v2).
- per-RT internal_buffer_offset/tile allocation use bpp*256*sample_count, rounded 1024. writeback_msaa=SINGLE for1; LAYERED for4/no resolve writing the MSAA target; AVERAGE for4/resolve with writeback base/row/stride/format from resolve target. Resolve target must be retained by bridge.
- Validation before output mutation: bad version/count/null samples, mixed sample counts, resolve for sample1, resolve dimensions/format/stride/span, missing target address, resolve aliasing target or another resolve? I propose target/resolve addresses may alias only when the target has no resolve; exact non-aliasing otherwise. 
- compute bridge: mirror pointers under N2MB_RENDER_TARGETS_MSAA_VERSION=3; resolve/retain resolve BOs with write=1; target BO write=1; no other layout change. Render: pass sidecar version3 and resolve addresses, only sample4 exact; retain resolve target.

T2 formats (after MSAA): n2r target bpp/internal/writeback mapping for 90 RGB10A2, 94 BGR10A2, 65 RG16F, 25 R16F, 125 RGBA32F, 55 R32F, 30 RG8, 110 RGBA16Unorm, 552/553 BGRA10_XR(+sRGB), 554/555 BGR10_XR(+sRGB), where v9/MTL internal+writeback mapping is exact. Sampling uses existing n2t helper mappings; n2r_bpp and RT packing will be extended only for formats with exact arch9 semantics. Unsupported depth/stencil/other T2 remain explicit refusals with reason. Host v9 pack/unpack for target descriptors and sample LUT; v1/v2 byte identity.

Please ACK or correct the v3 field names/version and resolve policy; no render_encoder edits by me. No phone/native/publish/commit.
